name: fred_industrial_production
description:
The US industrial production index from FRED, the St. Louis Fed's economic database: series INDPRO (index, monthly).
Returns {"series": "INDPRO", "data": <FRED observations response>}; data.observations = [{date (YYYY-MM-DD), value (a string, "." if missing), realtime_start, realtime_end}], newest first; data is {"error": ...} if the call fails.
Inputs (* required): limit (integer, number of newest observations; default 30).
Related: fred_capacity_utilization, fred_durable_goods.
Example: {"limit": 12}

limit.description: Number of most recent observations to return (newest first)
